non_idle_rule: After every result or interruption, immediately analyze, log, and launch the next experiment. The watchdog recovers only declared queued workers. When the queue is empty, the primary Codex process must plan and enqueue the next experiments. Wait only for an active process, active Codex planning, or required external operation. Stop only on exact top-level STOP.
current_hypothesis: Clean-validation class-bias calibration of the strongest encoder reduced macro F1 to 0.7252201015998959, so the calibration branch is closed without aggregate testing. A distinct 3072-token cross-entropy encoder with learning rate 1.5e-5 and label smoothing 0.005 may provide a robust alternative to the tested zero-smoothing 3072-token model. Candidate selection will use clean validation only.
